description: This file implements the logic for generating a sales partner target variance report based on item groups in an ERPNext system. It defines functions to retrieve and process sales data, compute variances, and generate report columns, primarily utilizing ERPNext's database interface and report utilities.

methods.name: get_data_column(filters, partner_doctype)
methods.description: Main entry point for fetching report columns and data based on filters and partner doctype, orchestrates data retrieval and prepares the report structure.

methods.name: get_data(filters, period_list, partner_doctype)
methods.description: Retrieves sales and item group data based on filters and period list, and prepares the data structure for reporting.

methods.name: get_columns(filters, period_list, partner_doctype)
methods.description: Generates the column definitions for the report, dynamically adding period-based columns for targets, achieved values, and variances.

methods.name: prepare_data(filters, sales_users_data, actual_data, date_field, period_list, sales_field)
methods.description: Processes raw sales data and distribution data to compute target, achieved, and variance figures for each combination of parent and item group.

methods.name: get_actual_data(filters, item_groups, sales_users_or_territory_data, date_field, sales_field)
methods.description: Fetches actual sales data from the database for specified sales users, item groups, and date range, respecting different document types.

methods.name: get_parents_data(filters, partner_doctype)
methods.description: Fetches target details for the sales partners and item groups, including target quantities or amounts, for the specified fiscal year.

ctags.name: prepare_data
ctags.pattern: /^def prepare_data(filters, sales_users_data, actual_data, date_field, period_list, sales_field):$/
